about.title: About this metric
about.steps: Steps counted by the iPhone and the band. When both record the same period, we count it once.
about.hr: Resting heart rate is estimated by the band while you are still. Training zones depend on your individual settings. This is not a health assessment.
about.cal: Active: estimated energy spent moving. Resting: energy your body uses at rest. The total comes from Apple Health — we never add different sources. Bands estimate; these are not exact values.
about.dist: We separate distance estimated from steps, activity distance and GPS distance. When sources record the same movement, we count it once.
about.sleep: Stages and duration are band estimates based on movement and heart rate. This is not a medical assessment.
about.weight: Scale weigh-ins arrive through Apple Health; manual entries are marked as "manual".

steps.bValue: when the band does not record

calc.title: How we calculate
calc.intro: The score goes from 0 to 100 and adds up four factors, using only data your band actually provides.

duration.description: How much you slept compared with your personal goal. Reaching the goal earns all 40 points.

regularity.description: Difference between the time you fell asleep and your average over the last 7 nights.

interruptions.description: Time awake and the number of wake-ups recorded by the band.

consistency.description: How similar your last 7 nights were in duration.

outside.title: Left out of the calculation
outside.text: Overnight HRV, skin temperature and blood oxygen are not provided by the Mi Band 8. We do not estimate those values — they simply are not included.

calc.note: The score is a personal trend reference. It is not a diagnosis or a medical assessment; sleep stages are device estimates.
calc.empty: No sleep recorded last night yet.
